story.title: Salman Khan was original target in shooting: Reports
story.summary: Tiger Shroff was targeted in a shooting incident that was initially directed at Salman Khan. The assailants abandoned their plan due to security measures at Khan's home. After monitoring Shroff through social media, they fired at his car in Juhu. Three shooters were arrested in Rajasthan, with connections to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang. story.title: Isha Koppikar regrets Dil Chahta Hai rejection
story.summary: Isha Koppikar says she regrets turning down Sonali Kulkarni’s role opposite Saif Ali Khan in “Dil Chahta Hai” due to a prior commitment to “Pyaar Ishq Aur Mohabbat.” The actor stresses adapting with age, avoiding creative compromises, and recalls “Ek Vivaah Aisa Bhi” and Sonu Sood fondly.
